explanation.headline: FDA's records show our tramadol hydrochloride supply is labeled by A-S Medication Solutions, which received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2026-08-12

sentences.text: The product label for tramadol hydrochloride (NDC 50090578902) identifies A-S Medication Solutions as the labeler and registered plant (FEI 1450743).
FDA issued a Warning Letter to A-S Medication Solutions LLC on 2017-06-05 (case 522197).
The most recent FDA inspection of this facility ended on 2026-08-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2026-10-14.
Prior inspections in 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2018 were also classified VAI.
Corvale East has 303 units on hand at 18.1 units per day, providing 17 days of supply.
Corvale General has 532 units on hand at 18.4 units per day, providing 29 days of supply.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-0c4e55.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%tramadol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%tramadol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-51440a.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f9282800-fde7-477a-8b8f-59617ec26f73') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-b6b008.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%tramadol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-f529b6.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%tramadol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-ae08fc.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%tramadol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-c52bdd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3008252295', '3007373532') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-5a0f72.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3008252295', '3007373532') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ab4efb.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450743') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-0ae1ca.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%tramadol%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-5c6908.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('50090578902')

Q-0a8071.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%tramadol%'
